title: Assembly Line Job Safety Analysis
description: Free Assembly Line Job Safety Analysis template for manufacturing you can edit online and download as PDF. Covers project information, job steps & hazard analysis.

Job Steps & Hazard Analysis

JOB STEPHAZARDS IDENTIFIEDPOTENTIAL CONSEQUENCERISK RATING (L x S)CONTROL MEASURES
1. Line Setup & Startup-Moving conveyor
-Pinch points
-E-stop malfunction		-Crush
-Entanglement
-Amputation		15 (HIGH)-Verify E-stops functional
-Check guarding in place
-Clear line of obstructions
-Test emergency stops
-Warn personnel before startup
2. Material Handling-Heavy lifting
-Repetitive motion
-Falling parts
-Awkward postures		-Back strain
-CTD
-Struck by parts		12 (HIGH)-Use lift assists for heavy parts
-Position materials ergonomically
-Rotate tasks
-Use anti-fatigue mats
-Maintain clear walkways
3. Assembly Operations-Hand tools
-Sharp edges
-Pinch points
-Air tools
-Noise		-Cuts
-Strikes
-Crush injuries
-Hearing loss		10 (MEDIUM)-Use ergonomic tools
-Keep tools in good condition
-Store tools properly
-Secure air hoses
-Use torque arms for heavy tools
4. Quality Inspection-Parts under magnification
-Reach issues
-Repetitive inspection		-Back strain
-Eye strain
-Ergonomic stress		8 (MEDIUM)-Use magnifying lamps if needed
-Take vision breaks
-Adjust workstation height
-Rotate inspectors
-Use automated inspection where possible
5. Line Clearance & Packout-Packaging equipment
-Pallet handling
-Forklift traffic		-Struck by moving equipment
-Crush injuries		6 (MEDIUM)-Use proper lifting techniques
-Keep hands clear of automated packers
-Watch for forklifts
-Stack pallets safely
-Maintain clear aisles
-Use warning lights

REQUIRED PPE: ☐ Hard Hat ☐ Safety Glasses ☐ Hearing Protection ☐ Steel-Toe Boots ☐ Gloves

☐ High-Vis Vest ☐ Arm guards (if needed)
